core_principles: Typography as the primary hierarchy mechanism
forbidden_elements: Box shadows (except ultra-subtle 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05) for absolute elevation)
Gaming/Cyberpunk tropes (neon, grids, skulls, shields, radars)

typography.serif: Fraunces, serif (Restricted to specific editorial headers only)

component_rules.badges: Square corners, uppercase, tight padding (px-2 py-0.5), monospaced or bold sans, 10px-11px text, 1px border. Backgrounds max 10% opacity.
component_rules.cards: Square corners, white surface, 1px subtle border. High contrast on hover (border turns black). No shadows.
component_rules.buttons: Square corners. Primary: Black bg, White text. Secondary: White bg, Black border. Hover state: Primary turns Accent Orange, Secondary border turns thicker or bg turns light gray.
component_rules.links: Bold sans or mono. No underlines by default. Underline or color change to Accent on hover.
component_rules.lists: Unstyled or subtle border-l. Data lists use mono font for labels.
